title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 4: Solomon's officials, his daily provision, his peaceful kingdom and his great wisdom.

questions.text: Who was over the army in Solomon's government?
questions.explanation: In the list of Solomon's princes, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army.

questions.text: Who was chief minister and called "the king's friend"?
questions.explanation: Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king's friend.

questions.text: How long did each of Solomon's twelve officers have to provide food for the king's household?
questions.explanation: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, and each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

questions.text: Which officer had Taphath, Solomon's daughter, as his wife?
questions.explanation: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor, had Taphath, Solomon's daughter, as wife.

questions.text: How does the chapter describe the people of Judah and Israel?
questions.explanation: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand by the sea, eating and drinking and making merry.

answers.text: Numerous as the sand, eating and drinking
Few in number and afraid of their enemies
Hungry and weak because of a long famine
Scattered far away among the nations

questions.text: Under what did every man live safely in the days of Solomon?
questions.explanation: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan to Beersheba.

answers.text: Under the shade of a palm tree
Under his vine and under his fig tree
In a tent of goat hair

questions.text: How many horsemen did Solomon have?
questions.explanation: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

questions.text: Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and of which land?
questions.explanation: Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

questions.text: How many proverbs did Solomon speak?
questions.explanation: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

questions.text: Solomon spoke of trees from the cedar in Lebanon even to which plant?
questions.explanation: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall.

answers.text: The hyssop that grows out of the wall
The olive tree on the hill
